title: Document
description: A single collected document and its extraction metadata (spec 9.7). Raw content stays separate: this record carries metadata, scores and a reference to the stored body, never the body itself.

document_id.description: Stable id for the document; the traceability anchor for every finding.

source_id.description: Id of the source this document was collected from.

source_name.description: Display name of the source at collection time.

source_url.description: URL of the source landing page, kept for display and traceability.

title.description: Document title as extracted from the page.

author.description: Author or publishing organisation when stated.

published_at.description: Publication date as stated by the page, ISO 8601. Null when unknown.

updated_at.description: Date the page was last updated as stated by the page, ISO 8601.

crawled_at.description: Timestamp when the body was fetched, ISO 8601.

first_seen_at.description: Timestamp when the URL was first discovered, ISO 8601.

canonical_url.description: Normalised canonical URL; the dedup key and the original address kept for the reader.

content_type.description: Media type of the fetched body, for example text/html.

language.description: Detected language of the body, BCP 47 style tag.

industry_tags.description: Industry tags used for classified archiving and local retrieval.

topic_tags.description: Topic tags used for classified archiving and local retrieval.

summary.description: Short compliant summary written by the host agent, not a copy of the article.

key_points.description: Key points extracted from this document alone.

entities.description: Named entities mentioned by this document.

relevance_score.description: Topical relevance to the research scope, 0-1.

freshness_score.description: Recency weight, 0-1. Affects ordering only, never admission.

novelty_score.description: How much new information this document adds, 0-1.

content_hash.description: Content fingerprint used for the second dedup layer.

raw_content_ref.description: Path or reference to the retained body. Absent when retention_mode is reference.

collection_method.description: How the body was obtained, for example http_get or manual_import.

compliance_record_id.description: Id of the compliance decision that allowed this collection.

crawl_status.description: Position in the document state machine. Failures are tracked separately with a reason, retry count and next allowed retry time.

retention_mode.description: How much of the original is kept. reference keeps only the link and permitted metadata; extracted keeps extracted facts; full_archive keeps the body.

date_confidence.description: Confidence in the stated dates, so an unknown date is never guessed.

round_discovered.description: Research round in which this document was discovered.

attempt_count.description: Number of fetch attempts so far.
